fields.name: mode
fields.tooltip: Beat the Clock: a set time to reach the end ramps. Arcade: a short clock that checkpoints, clean flying and patrol kills feed, and lost lives drain.

fields.name: timeLimitSeconds
fields.tooltip: The whole time to reach the end ramps, seconds. 0 = the saved track's own time limit, else GameSettings.timeLimitSeconds.

fields.name: startSeconds
fields.tooltip: What the clock starts on, seconds — enough to reach the first checkpoint at the reference pace, and little more.

fields.name: maxClockSeconds
fields.tooltip: The most the clock can hold, seconds: banking time is bounded, arcade style. Also caps Beat the Clock's start.

fields.name: lowTimeWarningSeconds
fields.tooltip: Below this the HUD clock turns red and pulses, seconds.

fields.name: autoCount
fields.tooltip: How many checkpoints a track WITHOUT authored ones gets, spread evenly from the first checkpoint distance to the start of the final run-up. A saved track's own Checkpoint placements always win — Edit Track's Lay Auto Checkpoints writes this same layout into the track to move and tune by hand.

fields.name: firstCheckpointMeters
fields.tooltip: Where the first auto checkpoint may stand at the earliest, metres from the start.

fields.name: featureClearance
fields.tooltip: An auto checkpoint keeps this far from a loop, a tube, a ramp and its landing, and a laser gate, metres. It slides forward past one, else back.

fields.name: paceShare
fields.tooltip: A checkpoint's award is the time to the next one at this share of the speed the ship CROSSES it at (never below the floor below), plus the grace: keep the pace you came in with and you make it. Below 1 is kinder — it allows for slowing down; above 1 asks you to speed up.

fields.name: paceFloorKmh
fields.tooltip: The slowest pace an award is ever sized for, km/h: a checkpoint crossed crawling still pays the time to the next one at this speed.

fields.name: graceSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds added to every checkpoint's award on top of the travel time — the slack for a fall, a sweep braked for, a bad line.

fields.name: awardBand
fields.tooltip: A checkpoint's award is never less / more than this band, seconds.

fields.name: awardScale
fields.tooltip: Every pace-sized award is multiplied by this AFTER the band: 0.5 pays half. The one knob for how generous the whole trial is. A checkpoint's fixed award (an override) is never scaled.

fields.name: cleanCheckpointBonus
fields.tooltip: Added on reaching a checkpoint with no hit since the last one (hull damage, a beam, a car, a fall, a life), seconds. A checkpoint on a saved track can override it.

fields.name: dirtyCheckpointPenalty
fields.tooltip: Taken away on reaching a checkpoint AFTER a hit since the last one, seconds. 0 = a dirty checkpoint just misses the clean bonus. A checkpoint on a saved track can override it.

fields.name: patrolKillBonus
fields.tooltip: Added when a patrol cruiser is destroyed — the finisher, or steered into a laser beam, seconds. A checkpoint on a saved track can override it for the stretch leading up to it.

fields.name: lifePenaltySeconds
fields.tooltip: Taken away when a life is lost (the hull reaches 0, or an arrest) — the ship respawns down the track, seconds. A checkpoint on a saved track can override it for the stretch leading up to it.

fields.name: trafficKillPays
fields.tooltip: A cruiser an oncoming car destroys pays the kill bonus too. Off: only the player's own kills pay.

fields.name: scrapeBreaksClean
fields.tooltip: Plain wall contact (the scrape) breaks a clean checkpoint as well. Off: only hard hits, beams, cars, falls and lives do.

fields.name: patrolEnabled
fields.tooltip: The patrol hunts in this level (and GameSettings.patrolEnabled is on). Arcade needs it for the kill bonus.

fields.name: gatePrefab
fields.tooltip: A checkpoint gate's picture, scaled across the road; empty = two code-built pylons and a beam overhead. Colliders are stripped — a checkpoint is judged on distance.

fields.name: gateHeight
fields.tooltip: Height of the code-built gate's beam above the road, metres.

fields.name: gateThickness
fields.tooltip: Thickness of the code-built pylons and beam, metres.

fields.name: showGateLabels
fields.tooltip: The floating text over each gate: the time it adds (sized live at the ship's speed, or its fixed award) and the clean bonus — or the dirty penalty once the run to it is dirty.

fields.name: labelGap
fields.tooltip: How far above the gate's beam the floating text stands, metres.

fields.name: labelSize
fields.tooltip: The floating text's character size (the loop gate's label is 5).

fields.name: debugLog
fields.tooltip: Logs every checkpoint laid and every clock change ([TimeTrial]).
